The underlying target addition was made by FHIR-30767 in commit 437ca7d6a01f5b5e580ba0f8ad596dabcb2aa4ef, which added RelatedPerson to Group.member.entity.
additional_context: Current source/ballot-intro.html is an R6 ballot roadmap and no longer includes the old R4B target-change list. Group remains active in source/fhir.ini, and source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml includes both the pre-existing Group target and RelatedPerson for Group.member.entity. FHIR-I minutes support the FHIR-30767 RelatedPerson decision and list FHIR-33196 as a technical correction; no conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current FHIR-core source is already correct for FHIR-33196 because the misleading ballot-intro text was corrected historically and is absent from the current build source.
